title: The Proving Stone
text: A sword is driven to the hilt into a boulder. Around the guard, many hands have gouged scratches where fingers clawed. A sign beside it is carved in a dead language, though everyone knows what it says.

options.label: The strongest tries the sword, as so many did before them.

outcomes.text: It comes out with a sound like a bell.
It does not move. The stone seems amused, and their arms ache for days.

options.label: The weakest tries it for luck; stranger things have happened.

outcomes.text: It comes out. Everyone is very quiet.
It does not move, but nobody laughs. They learn something from trying.

options.label: The sharpest reads the scratches to learn who clawed at the stone before.

outcomes.text: Hundreds of names are scratched there. Some are from your Houses, and some are fresh.
